capabilities: select and preview an NSX backup archive before importing
convert Note Station notes to Markdown with properties, tags and dates
map attachments by md5 and copy them into an Assets folder
generate an import report of missing assets and unresolved links
compare a later backup against a saved Source snapshot (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a sync tool; it performs a one-way import from an NSX backup file and does not watch for or fetch new backups.
extras: Freemium: core import is free; notebook mapping profiles and snapshot comparison require a paid GitHub Sponsors tier. After sign-in it makes GitHub network requests (device flow, read:user scope) but no telemetry; before sign-in it makes none. After updates it opens a promotional 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins, which can be turned off in settings. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. Encrypted, split and ZIP64 archives are rejected; encrypted note text is not decrypted.
problem: Obsidian has no way to read Synology Note Station NSX backup archives, so migrating notebooks, dates, tags and local attachments requires manual conversion.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: NSX importer that migrates Synology Note Station backups into a vault as Markdown notes with folders, tags, dates, attachments and an import report.
